final_message:
The refund failure was a wrong argument in `refund_invoice`, and it's fixed. All 25 tests pass.

**Root cause:** In `billing/refunds.py`, `refund_invoice` called `successful_payments(ctx, invoice["customer_id"])`. That function takes an `invoice_id` and looks up payments with `payments_for_invoice(invoice_id)`. Passing the customer ID matched no payments, so nothing was refunded. Because no credit was applied either, the code hit the `"invoice has no successful payment to refund"` error even though the customer had been charged.

**Fix:** `billing/refunds.py` now passes `invoice_id`:
```python
payments = successful_payments(ctx, invoice_id)
```

**Test:** I added `test_refund_paid_invoice_returns_charged_amount` to `tests/test_credit_notes.py`. It creates a subscription, collects payment, refunds the invoice, and checks that the credit note equals the invoice total and the payment is marked refunded. It fails without the fix with the reported error and passes with it. The test file also imports `payments` now.

**Answer file:** `answer.json` in the repo root contains `{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}`.

Nothing is committed.

steps.command: git ls-files && grep -rn "no successful payment" --include=*.py . | grep -v .venv
grep -rn "successful payment" billing tests; cat billing/refunds.py
cat billing/payments.py; grep -n "def payments_for\|def credit_notes_for" -A8 billing/store.py; grep -rn "invoice_id" billing/payments.py billing/models.py | head -30
grep -rn "refund" tests | head; grep -n "^def \|^from\|^import" tests/test_credit_notes.py | head -30
cat tests/test_credit_notes.py; cat tests/conftest.py | head -80; grep -n "def \|class " billing/gateway.py | head -30

cat >> tests/test_credit_notes.py <<'EOF'


def test_refund_paid_invoice_returns_charged_amount(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    if inv["status"] != "paid":
        payments.collect(world.ctx, inv["id"])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "paid"
    note = refunds.refund_invoice(world.ctx, inv["id"])
    assert note["amount"] == inv["total"]
    assert note["refunded"] is True
    assert all(p["status"] == "refunded" for p in world.ctx.store.payments_for_invoice(inv["id"]))
EOF
sed -i 's/^from billing import ledger, refunds$/from billing import ledger, payments, refunds/' tests/test_credit_notes.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30; git stash push billing/refunds.py -q && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; git stash pop -q && git diff --stat
